title: A role file, skill or kb/_self doc names no backlog item id as a standing example, since a closed sprint deletes its items
goal: backlog.py check (or the docs check) warns of a backlog item id in agents/, skills/ or a kb/_self rule doc that names no item file, and planning words a goal's examples so a worker does not copy an item id into a durable doc (SP-hlt2tdel: ST-lp5pxtpe's worker wrote BG-w6z2zc6r, done and deleted, into agents/worker.md rule 5 as an open-item example, copied from its goal; the orchestrator sent it back)

run:
import sys, tempfile, subprocess, pathlib
t = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
(t/'agents').mkdir(); (t/'skills'/'x').mkdir(parents=True); (t/'kb'/'_self').mkdir(parents=True)
(t/'agents'/'worker.md').write_text('Rule 5: an open item such as BG-w6z2zc6r is not touched.\n')
(t/'skills'/'x'/'SKILL.md').write_text('Say an id such as ST-xxxxxxxx.\n')
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/backlog.py', '--root', str(t), 'check'], capture_output=True, text=True)
out = r.stdout + r.stderr
sys.exit(0 if r.returncode == 0 and 'BG-w6z2zc6r' in out and 'ST-xxxxxxxx' not in out else 1)
